sources.title: ornith-1.5:122b-nvfp4
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5-122B delivers frontier-level capabilities with exceptional inference efficiency. With superior instruction following, stronger task decomposition, and deeper understanding of real-world workflows, it achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models of comparable size, while running on a single NVIDIA DGX card!

sources.title: Ornith AI
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 takes a major step toward building foundation models through end-to-end self-improvement, extending the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts.
